title: Theft (fictional proof structure)
text: A person is guilty of theft if the person took away an object that belonged to another person, knew it belonged to the other person, and intended to take it away. Not applicable if taking away prevents danger.
head: A person is guilty of theft if:
conditions: the person committed an action to take away the object,
the object belonged to another person,
the person knew that the object belonged to the other person, and
the person had an intention to take away the object
exception: The rule is not applicable if the purpose of taking away is to prevent dangers.
